meta.title: Hush, it's Sunday: why Germans happily let their shops stay shut
meta.deck: In a country famous for efficiency, one day a week is set aside for doing almost nothing at all.
meta.note: 这是一篇仿《经济学人》风格的原创练习文章，不是真实外刊的转载。文中的事实是概括性描述，仅供语言学习，请不要当作引用来源。

sents.en: Hush, it's Sunday: why Germans happily let their shops stay shut
sents.zh: 嘘，今天是星期天：德国人为什么乐意让商店关门
notes: Hush：嘘，叫人安静。
let ... stay shut：让……保持关闭。

sents.en: In a country famous for efficiency, one day a week is set aside for doing almost nothing at all.
sents.zh: 在一个以效率著称的国家，每周有一天专门留出来，几乎什么都不做。
notes: famous for：以……出名。
efficiency：效率。
be set aside for：被专门留出来做……。

sents.en: Newcomers grumble; most Germans would not have it any other way.
sents.zh: 新来的人抱怨连连；大多数德国人却觉得就该这样。
notes: grumble：抱怨（之前学过）。
would not have it any other way：不希望有任何改变，就喜欢这样。

sents.en: Arrive in a German town on a Sunday and you may think something has gone badly wrong.
sents.zh: 星期天到德国的某个小镇，你可能会以为出了什么大事。
notes: Arrive ... and you may think ...：祈使句 + and + 结果，相当于 If you arrive ..., you may think ...。
go badly wrong：出了大问题。

sents.en: Supermarkets are dark, department stores are locked, and the high street is eerily quiet.
sents.zh: 超市黑着灯，百货商店锁着门，商业街安静得出奇。
notes: department store：百货商店。
high street：（英式）主街、商业街。
eerily：怪异地、令人不安地。

sents.en: This is not a strike or a holiday; it is simply the law.
sents.zh: 这不是罢工，也不是节假日；这只是法律规定。
notes: strike：罢工。
分号前后对比：不是 A，而是 B。

sents.en: Sunday trading is tightly restricted, and the constitution itself protects the day as one of rest and spiritual uplift.
sents.zh: 星期天营业受到严格限制，而且宪法本身就把这一天定为休息和精神提升的日子。
notes: Sunday trading：星期天营业。
be tightly restricted：受到严格限制。
the constitution itself：宪法本身。uplift：提升、振奋。

sents.en: A few exceptions keep the country running.
sents.zh: 有几个例外让国家照常运转。
notes: exception：例外。
keep ... running：让……持续运转。

sents.en: Bakeries may open for a few hours, so that nobody is deprived of fresh rolls, and shops in railway stations do a roaring trade.
sents.zh: 面包店可以开几个小时，免得有人吃不上新鲜面包卷；火车站里的商店则生意兴隆。
notes: so that nobody is deprived of ...：以免有人得不到……。
deprive A of B：剥夺 A 的 B。
do a roaring trade：生意兴隆。

sents.en: Otherwise, anyone who forgot to buy milk on Saturday must wait, or knock on a neighbour's door.
sents.zh: 除此之外，谁要是星期六忘了买牛奶，就只能等着，或者去敲邻居的门。
notes: Otherwise：除此之外；否则。
anyone who ...：任何……的人。
knock on：敲（门）。

sents.en: The quiet extends well beyond the shops.
sents.zh: 这份安静远远不止于商店。
notes: extend beyond：延伸到……之外。well 加强语气：远远。

sents.en: In many places it is frowned upon, and sometimes against local rules, to mow the lawn, drill holes in walls or even drop bottles into a recycling bin on a Sunday.
sents.zh: 在很多地方，星期天割草、在墙上打孔，甚至把瓶子扔进回收箱，都会招人白眼，有时还违反当地规定。
notes: it is frowned upon ... to do：做……会被人不以为然，it 是形式主语。
mow the lawn：割草坪。drill holes：钻孔。

sents.en: The clatter of glass, the logic goes, should not disturb anyone's rest.
sents.zh: 按照这个逻辑，玻璃瓶的哐啷声不应该打扰任何人休息。
notes: clatter：哐啷声。
the logic goes：按照这种逻辑，插入语。

sents.en: Neighbours have been known to complain about a washing machine left spinning.
sents.zh: 曾经有邻居投诉别人家的洗衣机开着在甩干。
notes: have been known to do：曾经……过、有过……的情况。
a washing machine left spinning：被开着在甩干的洗衣机。

sents.en: Business groups have long argued that the rules cost money and hurt retailers competing with online shops.
sents.zh: 商界团体一直认为，这些规定让人损失钱财，伤害了要和网店竞争的零售商。
notes: have long argued that ...：长期以来一直认为。
retailer：零售商。competing with ...：现在分词作定语。

sents.en: Each attempt to loosen them meets fierce resistance from an unlikely alliance of churches and trade unions.
sents.zh: 每次想放宽这些规定，都会遭到一个意想不到的联盟的强烈反对：教会和工会。
notes: loosen：放松、放宽。
meet fierce resistance：遭到强烈抵制。
an unlikely alliance of A and B：A 和 B 意想不到的联合。

sents.en: Churches defend Sunday as sacred; unions defend it as the one day shop workers can count on spending with their families.
sents.zh: 教会捍卫星期天，是因为它神圣；工会捍卫它，是因为这是店员们唯一确定能和家人一起过的日子。
notes: defend A as B：以 B 为由捍卫 A。
sacred：神圣的。
the one day ... can count on spending ...：唯一能指望……的一天。

sents.en: Courts have mostly sided with them.
sents.zh: 法院大多站在他们一边。
notes: side with：站在……一边、支持。

sents.en: Many foreigners find the arrangement maddening at first and then, rather to their surprise, come to love it.
sents.zh: 很多外国人起初觉得这种安排让人抓狂，后来却出乎自己意料地爱上了它。
notes: find sth + 形容词：觉得……怎样。
rather to their surprise：颇出乎他们意料，插入语。
come to love：渐渐爱上。

sents.en: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue, people walk, cycle, visit relatives or linger over long lunches.
sents.zh: 没东西可买，也没地方排队，人们就散步、骑车、走亲戚，或者慢悠悠地吃顿长长的午饭。
notes: With nothing to buy and nowhere to queue：with 结构说明背景。
relative：亲戚。
linger over：在……上慢慢磨蹭、细细享受。

sents.en: Parks fill up; phones go quiet.
sents.zh: 公园里人满为患；手机都安静下来。
notes: fill up：坐满、挤满。
go quiet：变安静。go + 形容词表示“变得”。

sents.en: It is a weekly reminder that not every hour needs to be productive.
sents.zh: 这每周都在提醒人们：不是每个小时都必须有成效。
notes: a reminder that ...：提醒……（同位语从句）。
productive：有成效的、高产的。

sents.en: And on Monday morning, the shops open again, as punctual as ever.
sents.zh: 到了星期一早上，商店又照常开门，一如既往地准时。
notes: as punctual as ever：一如既往地准时。
as ... as ever：和以往一样……。

vocab.note: 感叹词：Hush, the baby's sleeping.（嘘，宝宝在睡觉。）名词 a hush fell over the room（屋里一下安静下来）。

ex.en: [[Hush]], you'll wake the baby!
ex.zh: 嘘，你会吵醒宝宝的！

ex.en: A [[hush]] fell over the crowd.
ex.zh: 人群一下子安静下来。

vocab.note: 形容词 efficient（高效的）。energy efficiency（能源效率）。

ex.en: The new system has improved [[efficiency]].
ex.zh: 新系统提高了效率。

ex.en: She works with great [[efficiency]].
ex.zh: 她工作效率很高。

vocab.note: set aside time / money for sth：为……留出时间 / 钱。过去式和过去分词都是 set。

ex.en: I [[set aside]] an hour a day for reading.
ex.zh: 我每天留出一小时读书。

ex.en: They [[set aside]] money for the holiday.
ex.zh: 他们为度假存了一笔钱。

vocab.expr: would not have it any other way
vocab.zh: 就喜欢这样、不想要别的样子
m: would not have it any other way
vocab.note: 表示对现状很满意，哪怕它有缺点：It's hard work, but I wouldn't have it any other way.
vocab.core: would not have it any other way
forms: would not have it any other way
wouldn't have it any other way

ex.en: Life with three kids is noisy, but I [[wouldn't have it any other way]].
ex.zh: 家里三个孩子很吵，可我就喜欢这样。

ex.en: The job is hard, but she [[wouldn't have it any other way]].
ex.zh: 工作很辛苦，但她乐在其中。

vocab.note: 用祈使句代替 if 条件句，后面接 and + 结果：Work hard and you'll pass.（努力，你就会及格。）接 or 表示“否则”：Hurry up, or you'll be late.（快点，不然要迟到了。）

ex.en: Turn left [[and you]]'ll see the station.
ex.zh: 向左转，你就会看到车站。

ex.en: Study every day [[and you]] will improve.
ex.zh: 每天学习，你就会进步。

vocab.conn: 祈使句（动词原形开头）+ and + 结果句；+ or + 否则的结果
vocab.say: Arrive in a German town on a Sunday and you may think something has gone badly wrong

pick.q: Leave now, ___ you'll miss the train.
pick.why: “现在走，否则会错过火车”，表示否则用 or。

pick.q: Smile at people, ___ they'll smile back.
pick.why: “对人微笑，他们就会回你微笑”，表示结果用 and。

vocab.note: 按部门（department）分区卖各种商品的大商店。

ex.en: She bought the coat in a [[department store]].
ex.zh: 她在百货商店买了这件外套。

ex.en: Many [[department stores]] are closing down.
ex.zh: 很多百货商店正在关门。

vocab.note: 英国城镇里商店集中的主要街道；美式说 main street。high-street shops：街边连锁店。

ex.en: There's a new café on the [[high street]].
ex.zh: 主街上新开了一家咖啡馆。

ex.en: Online shopping is hurting the [[high street]].
ex.zh: 网购正在冲击实体商业街。

vocab.note: eerie（怪异的、阴森的）+ -ly。eerily quiet（安静得出奇），eerily similar（相似得诡异）。

ex.en: The empty school was [[eerily]] quiet.
ex.zh: 空无一人的学校安静得诡异。

ex.en: The two stories are [[eerily]] similar.
ex.zh: 这两个故事相似得出奇。

vocab.note: go on strike（举行罢工），a train strike（火车罢工）。动词 strike 还有“打、击中”的意思。

ex.en: The workers went on [[strike]] for higher pay.
ex.zh: 工人们为了提高工资举行罢工。

ex.en: A rail [[strike]] has closed the stations.
ex.zh: 铁路罢工让车站都关了。

vocab.note: restrict sth to ...：把……限制在……。名词 restriction（限制）。

ex.en: Parking is [[restricted]] to residents.
ex.zh: 停车仅限居民。

ex.en: The new law [[restricts]] the sale of fireworks.
ex.zh: 新法律限制烟花的销售。

vocab.note: a country's constitution（国家的宪法）。形容词 constitutional（宪法的）。也指“体质”：a strong constitution。

ex.en: Free speech is protected by the [[constitution]].
ex.zh: 言论自由受宪法保护。

ex.en: She has a strong [[constitution]] and rarely gets ill.
ex.zh: 她体质好，很少生病。

vocab.note: 名词：spiritual uplift（精神提升）。形容词 uplifting（令人振奋的）：an uplifting story。

ex.en: The music gave everyone a sense of [[uplift]].
ex.zh: 音乐让每个人都很振奋。

ex.en: It's an [[uplifting]] film about friendship.
ex.zh: 这是一部关于友情的振奋人心的电影。

vocab.note: with the exception of（除……之外），make an exception（破例）。形容词 exceptional（杰出的）。

ex.en: Everyone came, with the [[exception]] of Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来了。

ex.en: I'll make an [[exception]] this time.
ex.zh: 这次我破个例。

vocab.note: deprive sb of sth：剥夺某人的……。be deprived of sleep（睡眠不足）。形容词 deprived（贫困的）。

ex.en: The prisoners were [[deprived of]] sleep.
ex.zh: 囚犯被剥夺了睡眠。

ex.en: Children should not be [[deprived of]] play.
ex.zh: 不应该剥夺孩子玩耍的权利。

vocab.note: 英式说法。roaring 之前学过（喧闹的；兴旺的）。Ice-cream sellers do a roaring trade in summer.

ex.en: Umbrella sellers [[did a roaring trade]] in the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨天卖伞的生意火爆。

ex.en: The new bakery is [[doing a roaring trade]].
ex.zh: 新开的面包店生意兴隆。

vocab.note: knock on the door。knock at the door 也可以。knock on wood：（美式）摸木头祈求好运。

ex.en: Someone is [[knocking on]] the door.
ex.zh: 有人在敲门。

ex.en: Please [[knock on]] my door if you need anything.
ex.zh: 需要什么就敲我的门。

vocab.note: extend a visit（延长访问），The garden extends to the river.（花园一直延伸到河边。）名词 extension。

ex.en: The deadline has been [[extended]] to Friday.
ex.zh: 截止日期延长到了周五。

ex.en: The forest [[extends]] for miles.
ex.zh: 森林绵延好几英里。

vocab.note: be frowned upon：被认为不妥。Smoking indoors is frowned upon.（在室内吸烟会招人反感。）

ex.en: Eating on the train is [[frowned upon]] here.
ex.zh: 在这里，坐火车时吃东西会招人白眼。

ex.en: Her parents [[frowned on]] the idea.
ex.zh: 她父母不赞成这个主意。

vocab.note: mow the lawn（割草坪）。lawnmower：割草机。过去分词 mown 或 mowed。

ex.en: He [[mows]] the lawn every Saturday.
ex.zh: 他每周六割一次草坪。

ex.en: The grass needs [[mowing]].
ex.zh: 草该割了。

vocab.note: drill a hole（钻个洞）。名词 an electric drill（电钻）。也指“操练”：a fire drill（消防演习）。

ex.en: He [[drilled]] a hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他在墙上钻了个洞。

ex.en: We have a fire [[drill]] every month.
ex.zh: 我们每个月有一次消防演习。

vocab.note: 硬物相撞的连续响声：the clatter of dishes（碗碟的碰撞声）。动词：Pans clattered to the floor.

ex.en: I heard the [[clatter]] of plates in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我听见厨房里碗碟碰撞的声音。

ex.en: The tray [[clattered]] to the floor.
ex.zh: 托盘哐啷一声掉在地上。

vocab.zh: 按照这种逻辑、照这个道理
vocab.note: 插入语，说明某种观点背后的想法，常带一点保留：The more you pay, the logic goes, the better it is.

ex.en: Cheaper food, [[the logic goes]], means healthier choices are harder.
ex.zh: 照这个道理，食物越便宜，健康的选择就越难。

ex.en: Shorter days, [[so the logic goes]], should mean less work.
ex.zh: 照这个逻辑，白天短了，活也该少了。

vocab.note: 说某人或某事有时会这样：He has been known to fall asleep in meetings.（他有时会在开会时睡着。）

ex.en: He [[has been known to]] sing in the shower.
ex.zh: 他有时会在洗澡时唱歌。

ex.en: Bears [[have been known to]] open car doors.
ex.zh: 熊曾经打开过车门。

vocab.note: 过去式 spun。spin around（转圈）。洗衣机的“甩干”叫 spin cycle。

ex.en: The washing machine is [[spinning]].
ex.zh: 洗衣机在甩干。

ex.en: She [[spun]] around to look.
ex.zh: 她转过身来看。

vocab.note: retail（零售）+ -er。wholesaler：批发商。

ex.en: Big [[retailers]] cut their prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商降了价。

ex.en: The [[retailer]] has 300 shops in Europe.
ex.zh: 这家零售商在欧洲有 300 家店。

vocab.note: loosen a tie（松开领带），loosen the rules（放宽规定）。反义 tighten（收紧）。

ex.en: He [[loosened]] his tie after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后他松了松领带。

ex.en: The government plans to [[loosen]] the rules.
ex.zh: 政府打算放宽规定。

vocab.note: fierce competition（激烈的竞争），a fierce dog（凶猛的狗）。

ex.en: There is [[fierce]] competition for jobs.
ex.zh: 求职竞争很激烈。

ex.en: The dog looked [[fierce]] but was friendly.
ex.zh: 那只狗看上去很凶，其实很友好。

vocab.note: unlikely（不太可能的、意想不到的）+ alliance（联盟）。an unlikely friendship（意想不到的友谊）。

ex.en: Farmers and artists formed an [[unlikely alliance]].
ex.zh: 农民和艺术家结成了意想不到的联盟。

ex.en: The two rival firms joined an [[alliance]].
ex.zh: 两家对手公司加入了同一个联盟。

vocab.note: 英式说法，美式说 labor union。也简称 union。

ex.en: She joined a [[trade union]] at work.
ex.zh: 她在单位加入了工会。

ex.en: The [[unions]] called for a strike.
ex.zh: 工会号召罢工。

vocab.note: a sacred place（圣地）。比喻：My weekends are sacred.（我的周末神圣不可侵犯。）

ex.en: The river is [[sacred]] to local people.
ex.zh: 这条河在当地人心中是神圣的。

ex.en: My morning coffee is [[sacred]].
ex.zh: 我早上的咖啡雷打不动。

vocab.note: side with sb against sb：站在某人一边反对另一人。

ex.en: My mum always [[sides with]] my sister.
ex.zh: 我妈总是站在我姐姐那边。

ex.en: The judge [[sided with]] the workers.
ex.zh: 法官支持了工人。

vocab.note: to one's surprise（令某人吃惊的是），rather 让语气更委婉、更英式。

ex.en: [[To my surprise]], she said yes.
ex.zh: 让我吃惊的是，她答应了。

ex.en: [[To our surprise]], the shop was open.
ex.zh: 出乎我们意料，那家店居然开着。

vocab.note: 表示态度慢慢转变：come to like / understand / realise。I came to love the city.（我渐渐爱上了这座城市。）

ex.en: I [[came to]] enjoy living alone.
ex.zh: 我渐渐喜欢上了一个人住。

ex.en: She [[came to]] realise he was right.
ex.zh: 她终于意识到他是对的。

vocab.note: close relatives（近亲），visit relatives（走亲戚）。形容词 relative 是“相对的”。

ex.en: We're visiting [[relatives]] this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末我们去走亲戚。

ex.en: She's a distant [[relative]] of mine.
ex.zh: 她是我的一个远房亲戚。

vocab.note: linger：逗留、不愿离开。linger over a meal / coffee：慢慢吃饭 / 喝咖啡。

ex.en: We [[lingered over]] coffee for an hour.
ex.zh: 我们慢悠悠地喝了一个小时咖啡。

ex.en: Don't [[linger over]] every question in the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时别在每道题上磨蹭。

vocab.note: go + 形容词表示变化：go quiet / go red（脸红）/ go bad（变质）。

ex.en: The room [[went quiet]] when she walked in.
ex.zh: 她一进来，屋里就安静了。

ex.en: My phone [[goes quiet]] after ten at night.
ex.zh: 晚上十点以后我的手机就静音了。

vocab.note: a reminder of / that ...。set a reminder（设个提醒）。动词 remind。

ex.en: I set a [[reminder]] on my phone.
ex.zh: 我在手机上设了个提醒。

ex.en: The photo is a [[reminder]] of happy days.
ex.zh: 这张照片让人想起快乐的日子。

vocab.note: a productive day / meeting（有成效的一天 / 会议）。名词 productivity（生产力）。

ex.en: It was a very [[productive]] meeting.
ex.zh: 这是一次很有成效的会议。

ex.en: I feel more [[productive]] in the morning.
ex.zh: 我早上效率更高。

vocab.note: 名词 punctuality（守时）。be punctual for sth（准时出席）。

ex.en: German trains are not always [[punctual]].
ex.zh: 德国的火车也不总是准时。

ex.en: She is always [[punctual]] for meetings.
ex.zh: 她开会总是很准时。

vocab.note: She looked as beautiful as ever.（她还是那么漂亮。）也单独用：As ever, he was late.（他一如既往地迟到了。）

ex.en: [[As ever]], the train was late.
ex.zh: 火车一如既往地晚点了。

ex.en: She's as busy [[as ever]].
ex.zh: 她还是那么忙。

cloze.hint: 就喜欢这样（would not have it any other ___）
（___ in a German town ... and you ...）

breakdown.en: In many places it is frowned upon, and sometimes against local rules, to mow the lawn, drill holes in walls or even drop bottles into a recycling bin on a Sunday.
points: 主干：it is frowned upon ... to mow the lawn, drill holes ... or even drop bottles ...。it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面三个 to do。
and sometimes against local rules：插入成分，补充说明“有时还违反当地规定”。
三个动作并列：mow the lawn（割草坪）、drill holes in walls（在墙上钻孔）、drop bottles into a recycling bin（往回收箱扔瓶子），or even 表示“甚至”。
on a Sunday 放在句末，说明这些事都是指星期天做。
